note: Small rustic Ottawa NF campground along the Sturgeon River beside the Sturgeon River Gorge Wilderness, 5 mi N of Sidnaw via FR 2200 (Kenton RD). Brown trout and steelhead; the river is floatable from here in high water (mid-April to June) but rocky with Class III-IV rapids. Sidnaw Creek Trail and the North Country Trail nearby. Site lengths not published. --Claude
